headline: Deck the Halls: The Holidays Land Tomorrow
tagline: Snow, Santa and a Nightmare Before Christmas mansion arrive Nov 13. Here's what to know for opening week.

lead.title: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort Begin Tomorrow, Nov 13
lead.body: The holiday season runs Nov 13, 2026 – Jan 6, 2027, with Santa moving to Mickey's Toontown Trolley Barn and Haunted Mansion Holiday marking its 25th year. "it's a small world" and Redwood Creek Challenge Trail are slated to reopen Nov 13 in holiday form.

events.title: Downtown Disney Country Concert Series
events.body: Live country bands on the Downtown Disney LIVE! stage, a new act most days. No park ticket needed.

events.title: Bountiful Valley Brews Opens
events.body: A new drinks-and-snacks spot near the front of the park. The menu includes a Pepperoni Pizza Egg Roll with pesto, a Pomegranate-Blueberry Refresher and a cocktail flight.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday Collectible Cards
events.dates: Card 3 Nov 9; card 4 Nov 16; through Nov 21
events.body: Collectible cards for Magic Key holders at Disneyana, Kingswell Shop and WonderGround Gallery.

events.title: Chip and Dale's Ornament Trail
events.body: Buy an activity map at a participating Downtown Disney shop and hunt down the ornaments. Per fan-site reports; confirm details on site.

events.title: "it's a small world" Holiday
events.body: The ride's holiday overlay is set to debut when the season starts; the closure began Oct 30. Reports note construction walls remain, so check the app.

events.title: Santa's Holiday Visit at Redwood Creek
events.body: Villains Grove is gone and the trail returns with Santa's holiday setup.

events.title: Pixie Hollow
events.body: Tinker Bell's meet-and-greet area is dark two days a week. Status as of Nov 3; confirm in the app.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday
events.body: Jack Skellington's Nightmare Before Christmas takeover of the Haunted Mansion runs into the new year.

events.title: Bluey's Best Day Ever!
events.body: A live stage show starring Bluey and Bingo. Showtimes vary, so check the Disneyland app.

events.title: Monsters, Inc. Mike & Sulley to the Rescue!
events.body: The Monstropolis dark ride is staying open longer than planned while construction for the Avatar-themed land is resequenced. No specific closing date has been announced.

events.title: Abbott Elementary Visits Disneyland
events.dates: Episode airing expected December; date TBA
events.body: The cast was spotted filming the show's 100th episode at the park in early October. Plot and air date haven't been announced.

events.title: Holiday Character Dining at Two Hotels
events.body: Holiday-themed character dining returns at two Disneyland Resort hotels.

events.title: World of Color – Season of Light
events.body: The holiday edition of World of Color returns to Paradise Bay.

events.title: Festival of Holidays & Santa
events.body: Six festive food marketplaces and the Sip and Savor Pass return, with a mariachi holiday show on Buena Vista Street. Santa greets at Redwood Creek Challenge Trail.

events.title: Handmade Candy Canes
events.body: Candy Palace and Trolley Treats pull handmade candy canes on these days. They sell out early, so arrive at park opening for a wristband. Dates as corrected by MiceChat.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa at Naples
events.body: A Downtown Disney breakfast with Santa. Reservations are open through Patina Group.

events.title: Remember… Dreams Come True Returns
events.body: A refreshed version of the Disneyland fireworks spectacular is slated to return in February 2027. Nightly schedules haven't been announced yet.

events.title: World of Color (Original) Returns
events.body: An updated version of the original World of Color is slated to return to Paradise Bay in February 2027.

events.title: Magic Happens Parade Returns
events.body: The daytime parade is expected back at Disneyland park next summer. Dates haven't been announced.

tip: Opening day Nov 13 will be busy. Arrive early, and grab candy cane wristbands on pull days (first is Nov 27).
caveats: Dates come from Disney press coverage and fan sites as of Nov 12, 2026. Always confirm in the Disneyland app.
